executiveSummary: 1 regression was observed in 'Login and Logout @shard2' with a new flaky rate of 17%.
The 'NML510 - Trial Balance Report @shard1' showed a failure rate improvement but introduced flaky behaviour.
The pivot date of 2026-09-18 coincides with these changes in test performance.
Flaky behaviour in 'Login and Logout @shard2' may indicate timing issues affecting reliability.
These issues could lead to inconsistent user login experiences and affect operational efficiency.
Further investigation into the test environment and timing patterns is recommended.
